query:
INSERT INTO goals (id, project_id, title, description, deadline, priority, sort_order,
                            status, is_archived, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
                 (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order) + 1, 0) FROM goals WHERE project_id = ?),
                 'open', 0, ?, ?)
